solution: For a preview, removing some perceptually less important audio data can reduce size and transfer time, though high compression may produce audible artifacts. Contract text must remain exact; irreversible loss could alter wording, so lossless compression is appropriate. The choice depends on tolerable loss, not simply which file is larger.

marking_points.criterion: Loss could change legally/semantically important wording.
Justified lossy audio versus lossless text choice.
